evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifting monotonically upward during growth (2.90 → 3.22 Torr) at constant Ar flow and temperature, suggesting partial exhaust restriction or leak
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so pressure rise is not flow-driven
Minor overshoot to 760°C at growth onset, then settled to setpoint
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; atmosphere purity cannot be verified as the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 reading (sensor absent) to rule out air ingress; continued pressure trend and a pump/exhaust valve or leak-check test to distinguish exhaust blockage from a seal leak
